yield: A yield is how much of a crop is grown in a year.
This year's harvest had a good yield.
To yield is to give way to someone or something else
Cars yield to the walkers when the walkers are in the crosswalk.
To yield is to produce something.
Most of the time, stocks yield more money than the original cost.
yip: A yip is a sharp, high-pitch bark.
To yip is to bark with a sharp, high-pitched voice.
yiddishism: A Yiddishism is a word from the Yiddish language that has become an English word.
Schmooze is an example of a Yiddishism
